expected_behaviors: other-tenant action never outranks own tenant
expired/unproven/blocked action never becomes next actionable item
duplicate source references are counted once

rootCause: First matching action could win despite lower relevance; status/tenant filtering and duplicate source references could overstate recommendations.
intervention: Deterministic read-only canonical goal-category/tenant/proof/policy/status selector; unique nonblank source count; no executor or new authority.
sourceOfTruth: Authenticated tenant-scoped Powerhouse executive projection and existing action safety and evidence contracts
prevention: Reject wrong tenant, stale/unproven, blocked, completed or in-flight actions; require canonical learning compiler fields and executable historical replay before admission; never treat recommendation as realized value.
promotion: Protected exact-head Required + CodeQL, BG169, Netlify SHA readback, independent tenant A/B evidence and canonical learning writeback; no bypass.
root_cause: The homepage originally selected the first matching action; the first candidate failed Required on missing learning failure class, and its same-lineage repair passed canonicalization but failed semantic closure because root_cause, prevention_rule and evidence keys were not present.
prevention_rule: Before remote release, run both learning-canonicalization and material-writeback semantic closure preflights; require root_cause, prevention_rule, evidence, compiler failure_class and executable historical_replay in the same file and exact candidate.
